description.zh: 期望服务端返回的数据压缩格式，支持 lz4
description.en: The compression format of the data that the server returns. Only the lz4 format is supported.

description.zh: 返回的Loggroup数目，最小值为1，最大值为1000。
description.en: The number of LogGroups to return. The value must be an integer from 1 to 1000.

description.zh: 游标，表示从什么位置开始读取数据，相当于起点。
description.en: The cursor that specifies the start position from which to read data.

description.zh: 结束游标，表示读取数据到什么地方结束，相当于终点。
description.en: The cursor that specifies the end position at which to stop reading data.

description.zh: 过滤语句，spl 语法，请参见[SPL指令](~~2536530~~)
description.en: The filter statement in the Structured Process Language (SPL) syntax. For more information, see [SPL instructions](~~2536530~~).
The ID of the shard in the Logstore.

descriptions.zh:
><warning>目前OpenAPI SDK不支持此接口，请使用[日志服务SDK](~~29063~~)。></warning>

* 获取日志时必须指定Shard。
* 目前仅支持读取[Protocol Buffer](~~29055~~)格式数据。
* 请求语法中Host由Project名称和日志服务Endpoint构成，您需要在Host中指定Project。
descriptions.en:
><warning>

This operation is not supported by the OpenAPI SDK. Use the [Simple Log Service SDK](~~29063~~).

></warning>

- Specify a shard to retrieve logs.

- This operation supports reading data in only the [Protocol Buffer](~~29055~~) format.

- The Host in the request syntax consists of the project name and the Simple Log Service endpoint. Specify the project in the Host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls pull-logs --project ali-test-project --log-store ali-test-logstore --shard-id 1 --cursor MTQ0NzMyOTQwMTEwMjEzMDkwNA --count 1000 --end-cursor MTU1NzA1NzQwMTEwMjEzMDkwCg --query 0_where_userId=_123 --accept-encoding lz4 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls GET /logstores/ali-test-logstore/shards/1?type=log --region cn-hangzhou --cursor MTQ0NzMyOTQwMTEwMjEzMDkwNA --end_cursor MTU1NzA1NzQwMTEwMjEzMDkwCg --query '0_where_userId=_123' --count 1000 --header "Accept-Encoding=lz4" --header "Content-Type=application/json"
